claims.text: The study uses a manually-curated dataset of publicly disclosed vulnerabilities for training, validation, and testing, with specific splits of 808, 265, and 264 commits.
Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entries are utilized for vulnerability management data in the study.
The evaluation includes 635 publicly disclosed vulnerabilities to assess the models' performance.
